verdict.rationale: BVNK documents creating crypto and fiat wallets through the API, including per-customer wallets via a customer ID and reference. It also documents deposit addresses, both persistent channel addresses and unique per-payment blockchain addresses. However, the evidence never describes key custody semantics, such as who holds private keys or the custodial model. missing for 10: documented key custody semantics, explicit API endpoint detail for provisioning deposit addresses/channels, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create wallets programmatically — per-customer or per-purpose wallets and deposit addresses provisioned through the API with documented key custody semantics

citations.quote: Specify a customer's ID and reference to create wallets for them; otherwise, the wallet is created for your own account.
On BVNK, you can create and manage both crypto and fiat wallets through the Portal or API.
A channel is a unique, repeated-use blockchain address that can receive crypto or stablecoins at any time. The address never changes.
For every payment, BVNK generates a live quote to be accepted by the customer and a unique blockchain address for the payment to be made to.
